name: @gino/host-store-sqlite
description: Gino host Storage adapter — drizzle-orm over sqlite (bun:sqlite).

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --packages external --external bun:sqlite && bun build src/schema.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --packages external && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
